evaluation_label: KID-5k and FID-5k 5,000-sample proxies; not standard 50,000-sample benchmarks
interaction_note: The additive_interaction raw contrast is C-G-L+F. Its paired log contrast is the multiplicative interaction log(C*F/(G*L)).

selection_overlap.description: seed 0 selected g* in the response curve and is reused in the fixed/global formal cells

statistics.ci: two-sided 95% Student-t interval around the paired mean
statistics.inference_scope: descriptive only; n=3 is insufficient for broad significance claims
statistics.wins_definition: number of negative paired contrasts out of 3; lower is better
